$comment: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware: /on/demandware.static/, Sites-int-us-Site) with Interface's own 'b-product_*' theme (US store). Prices are in US dollars and are returned in cents with currency USD. The server HTML has no price at all: div.b-product_details-price is hidden and holds 'N/A', and the real price is injected by the priceBlock label widget (the JSON-LD Offer has no price either), so price is not configured and every product returns price.state 'unknown' with a PRICE_MISSING warning. Product URLs end in the upper-case SKU (A043R.html, canonical A04302144020103XX0.html). The gallery is server-rendered as Scene7 URLs (the desktop hero close-up sits outside the product root, in l-pdp-main); the description is div.b-product_description-content; the specifications are five accordions (Product, Performance, Health + Environmental, Packaging, Technical Information: 39 rows) inside #attribute-section-wrapped. The order button is button.b-order_sample ('Order Sample' and 'Add to Cart'); the out-of-stock class m-outofstock is inferred from the m-instock class seen on the same section, and the order button is the primary stock signal. Checked against a saved (curl) Cut & Form 4.5 mm product page on 2026-11-12.
